title: add per-prompt CI metrics + quality gating hook
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds per-prompt CI metrics collection and a configurable quality-gating hook usable in hosted and self-hosted CI. Backwards compatible; no user-facing API changes.
description:
Motivation: regressions can be prompt-specific and are missed by aggregate eval metrics. This PR adds per-prompt metric collection to the eval-harness CI flow and a reusable quality gating hook that fails builds when a prompt's metrics fall below configurable thresholds.

What I changed: added a lightweight CI hook that runs evals at PR time for a selected prompt-set, aggregates metrics per-prompt (accuracy, bleu, avg_probability, token_coverage), and compares them to historical baselines stored in the metrics backend. The hook is configurable via ci/configs/per_prompt_gate.yml (thresholds, sample size, rolling window).

Key files: ci/hooks/per_prompt_metrics.py (main hook), eval_harness/quality/gating.py (gating util), ci/configs/per_prompt_gate.yml.example, tests/ci/test_per_prompt_metrics.py, docs/ci/per-prompt-metrics.md, scripts/metrics_backfill.py.

Checklist: 
- [x] per-prompt metrics collection and aggregation implemented
- [x] gating comparison against baseline with clear failure reasons
- [x] unit tests for gating logic and CI hook (fast mocks)
- [x] simple docs and example config
- [x] integration run in ephemeral CI enabled for the feature branch

Testing: ran unit tests locally and in CI, ran end-to-end integration in a staging pipeline against a 50-prompt sample (sanity-only sampling to keep CI time reasonable). Observed expected failures for intentionally degraded model variant and green for baseline.

Rollout plan: feature gated behind a CI flag. We'll enable for the repo's model onboarding workflows first, then roll out to all repos in a staged manner. The gating thresholds are editable in the config and default to opt-in.

Notes: this PR intentionally avoids modifications to the core eval runner to keep diffs small; it composes existing runner APIs to produce per-prompt metrics. Follow-up PR planned to optionally persist per-prompt time series for long-term alerting.
